description: SRD 3.5: Sela, a sorcerer 4, has already cast one magic missile today (Cha 16: 7 first-level casts a day) and casts it at the four skeletons the module's notes put in the entry hall, then again until the pool refuses. A sorcerer memorizes nothing: a spell declared in combat_round is spent by the round (cast_spell outside a fight), never cast_spell for it too, and the DM never calls memorize_spells; her six casts fell three skeletons, the round refuses the seventh in the fight, and the DM says she is out of 1st-level spells, her 2nd-level ones left.

secrets.text: Four skeletons stand in the entry hall, waiting for the living; each has the SRD's 6 hit points.

beats.player: Sela casts magic missile at the skeleton.
And again, and again until she can't.
